automated_gate_policy.blocked_rule: Any required producer non-pass, missing native required surface, or blocking native warning blocks the combined judgment.
automated_gate_policy.not_evaluated_rule: No package is emitted when validation or native invocation fails; a future explicit unavailable surface remains not-evaluated.
automated_gate_policy.satisfied_rule: All required producer checks pass and the native ae-framework judgment is satisfied.
automated_gate_policy.satisfied_with_warnings_rule: All required producer checks pass and every native warning is explicitly reviewed as visible-nonblocking.

limitations: ae-framework organizes supplied Evidence and is not an oracle of truth.
The output is neither a security proof nor certification.
Combined automated satisfaction is not human approval or publication approval.
Fixture producers are synthetic and do not establish Product correctness.
Private-candidate inputs are digest-only metadata and remain public-export-ineligible.
The current runner cannot ingest or emit an approved or rejected human decision.
Private-candidate execution-tool metadata is supplied and digest-bound under closed roles but is not independently authenticated by this runner.
Distinct supplied implementation digests do not prove organizational or execution independence.
Protocol and conformance labels are accepted only from the exact reviewed public authority.
Formal-tool records are proof-check metadata only; bounded model-check Evidence requires a future reviewed producer contract.
Validation timestamps are supplied and digest-bound but are not externally timestamp-attested.
Every producer and Evidence record is structurally bound to the one reviewed conformance-suite digest; supplied case, input, and Product digests are not independently attested by this runner.
